newsitem.title: LATVIA: HANSBANK TO ISSUE OWN AND OTHERS' CARDS.
newsitem.headline: HANSBANK TO ISSUE OWN AND OTHERS' CARDS.

text.p: Hansabank-Latvija said on Wednesday it will issue its own bank cards in April and will soon start handling Visa, Eurocard/MasterCard, and edc/Maestro.
"Hansabank-Latvija became a member of Visa International in March, which will allow it to start issuing and handling Visa cards," the bank said in a statement.
The bank also said that it expected to start issuing edc/Maestro cards in May and Eurocard/MasterCard in June.
Hansabank-Latvija cards will allow clients to withdraw cash from cash machines as well as carry out transactions in their accounts.
Hansabank has issued more than 900 Globus cards, which can be used in Latvia and Lithuania for payments as well as for withdrawing cash.
